吴灿锋端着咖啡喝了一口：“什么人？”

“我手下刑警队的，叫苏楠。”

吴灿锋放下杯子，表情没变，但眼皮直跳：“刑警？”

“你别管她是干什么的，我的人我自有安排，你只管把人弄走，找个地方关一段时间就行，不要伤她，事成之后，少不了你的好！”

吴灿锋沉默了一会儿，抬起头看了江绍庭一眼，点了下头。

画面到此结束。

顾承安慢慢放下筷子。

他低头看着碗里还剩半碗的米饭，忽然觉得有点吃不下去了。

不是菜不好吃。

是恶心。

绑架苏楠这件事的全部链条，此刻在他脑子里连成了一条完整的线——

真正的幕后主使是江绍庭，动机不明，但直接指名要苏楠消失。

江绍庭下达密令给吴灿锋。

吴灿锋接单，掏了两千万交给自己的核心手下阿绍——就是马文昌口中的“少爷”。

少爷拿出一千五百万找到马文昌。

马文昌吃掉一千万，拿五百万雇了刘大勇、赵虎、王强三个工具人。

层层转包，层层抽水，活脱脱一个甲方-总包-分包-劳务队的完美施工图。

而最上面那个甲方——是公安局副局长江绍庭。

分管刑侦的副局长，亲手下令绑架自己分管内的刑警。

顾承安重新拿起筷子，把碗里剩下的饭一口一口吃完了。

浪费粮食不好。

他喝了一口花胶鸡汤，汤确实鲜，花胶弹牙，鸡肉炖得酥烂入味。

三千块的鸡汤，每一口都得喝出三千块的仪式感来，不能亏了自己。

吃完最后一口时蔬，擦嘴，放下餐巾。

顾承安抬手招了一下：“买单。”

服务生小跑过来，手持一个皮质账单夹，恭恭敬敬地放在桌上。

翻开，3888元。

他低头扫了一遍明细，米饭28，时蔬188，烧鹅688，花胶炖鸡——2999。

顾承安的眉头动了一下，尽管点的时候已经知道价格了，还是忍不住一阵心惊肉跳。

就这么一小盅？

Wu Canfeng took a sip of coffee and said, "Who is it?"

"My name is Su Nan from the criminal police team."

Wu Canfeng put down the cup, his expression did not change, but his eyelids twitched: "Interpol?"

"Don't worry about what she does. I have my own arrangements for my people. Just take them away and find a place to lock them up for a while. Don't hurt her. Once the matter is done, your kindness will be indispensable!"

Wu Canfeng was silent for a while, raised his head, glanced at Jiang Shaoting, and nodded.

The scene ends here.

Gu Chengan slowly put down his chopsticks.

He looked down at the half-bowl of rice left in the bowl, and suddenly felt a little unable to eat any more.

It’s not that the food isn’t delicious.

It's disgusting.

The entire chain of the kidnapping of Su Nan was now connected into a complete line in his mind——

The real mastermind behind the scenes was Jiang Shaoting. His motives were unknown, but he directly named Su Nan to disappear.

Jiang Shaoting issued a secret order to Wu Canfeng.

Wu Canfeng accepted the order and paid 20 million to his core subordinate A Shao - the "young master" in Ma Wenchang's mouth.

The young master spent fifteen million to find Ma Wenchang.

Ma Wenchang ate 10 million and used 5 million to hire three tool men, Liu Dayong, Zhao Hu and Wang Qiang.

Subcontracting layer by layer, pumping water layer by layer, it looks like a perfect construction drawing of Party A-general contractor-subcontractor-labor team.

And the Party A at the top is Jiang Shaoting, deputy director of the Public Security Bureau.

The deputy director in charge of criminal investigation personally ordered the kidnapping of the criminal police officer in his charge.

Gu Chengan picked up the chopsticks again and ate the remaining rice in the bowl in one bite.

It is not good to waste food.

He took a sip of fish maw chicken soup. The soup was really fresh, the fish maw was chewy and the chicken was stewed until it was crispy and delicious.

Three thousand yuan worth of chicken soup, every sip has to bring out the ritual feeling of three thousand yuan, so you can’t lose yourself.

After finishing the last bite of vegetables, wipe your mouth and put down your napkin.

Gu Chengan raised his hand and waved: "Pay the bill."

The waiter trotted over, holding a leather bill folder and placing it respectfully on the table.

Open it, 3888 yuan.

He lowered his head and scanned the details: rice 28, seasonal vegetables 188, roast goose 688, fish maw stewed chicken - 2999.

Gu Chengan's brows moved. Even though he already knew the price when he ordered it, he couldn't help but feel frightened.

Just such a small cup?
